topic: Behcet disease: oral and genital ulcers, uveitis, pathergy, colchicine, immunosuppression

source.title: EULAR recommendations for the management of Behçet's syndrome: 2025 update
source.whyItFits: The stored abstract of the 2025 EULAR update states the overarching principles and the organ-grouped treatment recommendations, including colchicine first-line for mucocutaneous and joint disease and early monoclonal TNF inhibitors for organ-threatening disease. The 2018 full text is not in PMC. A 2026 organ-involvement systematic review was downloaded but does not state the colchicine recommendation.

notes: Pathergy and a specific uveitis drug ladder are not in the stored abstract.
